universal_guidelines: Ensure all interactive elements have hover states (text color change, glow, or scale).
Use 'uppercase' and 'tracking-widest' for all navigation links and headers to maintain the 'Architectural' aesthetic.
Mega Menus must use AnimatePresence for smooth fade-in/out.
Do not use solid white backgrounds. Use dark backgrounds with low opacity (glassmorphism).
Primary Action buttons should use the Cyan accent color (#22D3EE).
All inputs/forms in footer should be minimalist (transparent bg, bottom border only).
Mobile menu must be a full-screen overlay with large typography.
Ensure all interactive and key informational elements have a data-testid attribute.
instructions_to_main_agent: Refactor Navbar.js and Footer.js to match the premium B2B aesthetic. Use the provided image URLs for the mega menu visuals (e.g., a small side column in the 'Products' dropdown showing a featured image). Ensure the 'Sparkle' on the logo is implemented via CSS animation (e.g., a small shining pseudo-element on the 'X').
